units: <cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 7:6">Keth. VII, 6</cite> <he>המקללת יוֹלְדָיו בפניו</he> she who curses his (her husband’s) parents in his presence; quot.

<cite ref="Ketubot 72b:5">ib. 72ᵇ</cite> <he>יוֹלֵידָיו</he> (an emphatic form), and interpreted <he>במקללת יוֹלֵידָיו בפני מוֹלֵידָיו</he> (v. <cite ref="M00490"><he>מוֹלֵד</he></cite>) also when she curses his parents before any one of his begotten; Y. ib. VII, 31ᵇ bot. <he>וולדיו בפני יולדיו</he>, v. <cite ref="F00061"><he>וָלָד</he></cite>.
